### Soundless Step { #awakening-soundless-step }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/nagi/soundless_step.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user moves without making any sound so monsters lose track of them and can't find them again. The first hit breaks the silence and deals a lot more damage.

### Dead Air { #awakening-dead-air }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/nagi/dead_air.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

While Silent is active enemies around the user can't use Observation Haki so they can't see auras or dodge with future sight.
